source_spec_relationship: Uses the same six experimentally mapped contacts. This is a separate two-target explanatory association family, not a replacement for the two R12 cross-layer primary tests or an independent replication of prior cell-line analyses.
cohort: Cell lines with complete protein, RNA and CNV for ARID1A and all six contacts, known lineage, and both prespecified target dependency scores. Both targets use exactly the same complete-case rows.
patient_selection: Reuse R12 patient selection: after assay-index and valid-lineage matching, keep the lexicographically smallest ModelID per known patient, before shared complete-case filtering. Unknown patient identifiers are cell-specific. Do not substitute a different same-patient line when the selected line has missing bridge measurements.
module_model: For each of the six fixed contact genes, OLS protein ~ own RNA + own CNV + lineage. Globally center and scale each residual vector to sample SD 1 (ddof=1), then take their equally weighted mean. Neither target dependency is used to select genes, signs, weights, covariates or transformations. ARID1A and ARID1B are never module members.
conditional_association_model: For each target, regress the target dependency and the protein module separately on the identical covariates ARID1A protein + ARID1A RNA + ARID1A CNV + lineage. Compute Spearman correlation of the two residual vectors. This is residual Spearman coupling after linear adjustment, not a rank-transformed partial-Spearman regression.
descriptive_incremental_r_squared: In the same rows, compare OLS dependency ~ ARID1A protein + ARID1A RNA + ARID1A CNV + lineage with the model additionally containing the fixed protein module. Report in-sample ordinary R-squared and its increment without a separate P value or any claim of generalizable prediction. The full model must separately meet the minimum residual-df rule.
resampling: Stratified nonparametric cell-row bootstrap within lineage with shared indices for both dependency targets and every assay. Preserve repeated draws. Refit all six RNA/CNV/lineage models, recalculate residual standardization and module means, and refit both common-covariate regressions in every replicate. No resampling or reselection of genes.
uncertainty: Percentile 95% CI for residual rho plus two-sided centered approximate bootstrap P=(1+count(abs(rho_boot-rho_obs)>=abs(rho_obs)))/(1+B_valid). This is not an exact null test; percentile CI and centered P are not strictly dual. A primary result requires at least 95% valid replicates.
multiplicity: BH over exactly the ARID1A and ARID1B residual-correlation tests. Retain family size two even if one is non-evaluable. This family is reported distinctly from the original R12 cross-layer and external-replication families; do not claim study-wide FDR control.
non_evaluable_policy: Do not omit, replace, reweight or impute a missing or zero-residual-variance module member. Insufficient shared n, insufficient module/conditional-model df, or a degenerate fixed module makes the relevant association non-evaluable. A constant target invalidates only that target, not the other target. Retain corrected-null estimates.
interpretation: Negative rho means a higher adjusted protein-module score accompanies stronger (more negative) dependency; positive rho means weaker dependency. Conditioning on measured ARID1A protein asks about coupling beyond the measured anchor and may remove a biologically mediated component or introduce conditioning bias. Association does not establish protein degradation, complex stability, causal dependency, cBAF-specific synthetic lethality, treatment benefit or generalizable prediction. No new deep-learning or supervised feature-selection model is introduced.
